description: Current order book (bids and asks) for one unified symbol.

depth.description: alias for limit (price levels per side)

exchange.description: exchange id, e.g. "binance" — validated against ccxt.exchanges; discover ids with list_exchanges

marketType.description: market type routing for exchanges with several (e.g. "spot", "swap", "future", "option") — sets options.defaultType on a dedicated instance

params.description: extra exchange-specific parameters passed through to ccxt unchanged (e.g. {"until": 1673000000000}) — discover supported keys with describe_method

prediction.description: set true to use the prediction-markets variant of an exchange that exists in both namespaces (e.g. hyperliquid)

name: get_orderbook
title: Get order book
